reason: A DeepSeek Harness web-interface enhancement centered on Workspace navigation and panels, combining task execution, Git visualization, file previews, conversation navigation, theming, model settings, and service usage displays.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供工作区导航与面板增强，包括任务看板、Git 图谱、文件浏览、对话导航、主题和模型设置等功能。
summaries.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness web interface with workspace navigation and panels for task boards, Git graphs, file browsing, conversation navigation, themes, and model settings.

capabilities: creates task-board entries with cron scheduling
starts agent sessions that can use bash and file read/write tools
reads and modifies workspace files and Git state
checks out branches and supports staging, unstaging, and discarding changes
calls balance, quota, model, and image-processing endpoints
injects a configurable global system prompt into sessions
persists plugin settings and UI data in browser storage
